audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5, level 6 and first item are charted as 'Skill/Skill/Shen' in the content layer and 'Skill/Skill/Shen' in the full layer, while the prose on the same page calls 4-5 Shen's window and level 6 and first item 'your peak'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill, Shen, Shen, Shen, Gragas, Gragas, Shen — which is what whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] already argue.
audit.corrected: Level 1 even, Levels 2-3 Shen, Levels 4-5 Shen, Level 6 Gragas, first item Gragas, two items Shen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shadow Dash is tracked all over the page with no number, and level 6 / first item were not credited to Gragas as spikes.
audit.why: enemyKit E cd 18/16/14/12/10 — an 18-second taunt at rank 1 is the single longest punish window in the lane, and it is why levels 6 and first item are yours.
audit.corrected: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1, 14s at rank 3; commit inside that window.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] claims Spirit's Refuge eats 'the casks you walk in to detonate'. Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS, not abilities — Barrel Roll, Body Slam and Explosive Cask all land through it. Also unstated: Stand United is a channel, so your Body Slam stun or Explosive Cask knockback cancels the teleport.
audit.why: Riot text on W: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Riot text on R plus the channel flag: 'shields target allied champion ... and soon after teleports'. Only the Drunken Rage empowered basic attack is denied by the zone.
audit.corrected: Refuge blanks your empowered auto and Happy Hour auto-procs only — keep casting abilities into it; and interrupt Stand United with E or R to strand him.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged "Drop Spirit's Refuge" — false positive, the name is exact.

notes: The page told the player Spirit's Refuge eats his casks. It does not — Riot's text blocks attacks, so only the Drunken Rage empowered basic attack and Happy Hour auto-procs are denied; every Gragas ability lands through the zone. That single correction changes how the whole lane is traded. Second addition: Stand United is a channel, so Body Slam or Explosive Cask cancels his global — nothing on the page mentioned an interrupt. Level charts on both layers now match packet.levelChart, which the existing whys[] prose already supported.
